steps.title: Строки, REGEXP, DML
steps.content:
## Строки

`SUBSTR`, `||`, `LOWER`/`UPPER`. **`REGEXP`** — JS RegExp. DML с **`checkQuery`**: проверяется состояние таблиц.

content.caption: DELETE/UPDATE проверяются через checkQuery
content.description: Результат DELETE без SELECT сравнивается по checkQuery.

content.description:
Имена: первая буква заглавная, остальные строчные. Колонки `user_id`, `name`. Сортировка по `user_id`.

[LeetCode 1667](https://leetcode.com/problems/fix-names-in-a-table/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Users(user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL);
content.referenceSolution: SELECT user_id, UPPER(SUBSTR(name, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(name, 2)) AS name FROM Users ORDER BY user_id;

content.description:
Пациенты с кодом, **начинающимся** с `DIAB1` (коды через пробел). Колонки `patient_id`, `patient_name`, `conditions`.

[LeetCode 1527](https://leetcode.com/problems/patients-with-a-condition/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Patients(patient_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, patient_name TEXT NOT NULL, conditions TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT patient_id, patient_name, conditions FROM Patients WHERE conditions LIKE '%DIAB1%';
content.referenceSolution: SELECT patient_id, patient_name, conditions FROM Patients WHERE conditions REGEXP '(^| )DIAB1';

tests.seed: INSERT INTO Patients VALUES (1,'Daniel','YFEV COUGH'),(2,'Alice',''),(3,'Bob','DIAB100 MYOP'),(4,'George','ACNE DIAB100'),(5,'Alain','DIAB201'),(6,'Zed','SADIAB100');

content.setup: CREATE TABLE Person(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL);
content.referenceSolution: DELETE FROM Person WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT MIN(id) FROM Person GROUP BY email);
content.checkQuery: SELECT id, email FROM Person ORDER BY id;

content.description:
Второй по величине **уникальный** оклад как `SecondHighestSalary`; если нет — одна строка `NULL`.

[LeetCode 176](https://leetcode.com/problems/second-highest-salary/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Employee(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, salary INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT salary AS SecondHighestSalary FROM Employee ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT (SELECT DISTINCT salary FROM Employee ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1) AS SecondHighestSalary;

steps.title: 1484. Group Sold Products By The Date

content.description:
По каждой `sell_date` — строка `sold_num` (число **разных** товаров) и `sold_products` (имена через запятую **по алфавиту**).

[LeetCode 1484](https://leetcode.com/problems/group-sold-products-by-the-date/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Activities(sell_date TEXT NOT NULL, product TEXT NOT NULL);
content.referenceSolution: SELECT sell_date, COUNT(DISTINCT product) AS sold_num, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT product) AS sold_products FROM Activities GROUP BY sell_date ORDER BY sell_date;

steps.title: 1327. List the Products Ordered in a Period

content.description:
Товары с **≥ 100** единиц, заказанных в период «2020-02-01»–«2020-02-28». Колонка `product` (имя), без дубликатов.

[LeetCode 1327](https://leetcode.com/problems/list-the-products-ordered-in-a-period/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Products(product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_name TEXT NOT NULL, product_category TEXT);
CREATE TABLE Orders(product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, order_date TEXT NOT NULL, unit INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT product_name AS product FROM Products;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name AS product FROM Orders o JOIN Products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN "2020-02-01" AND "2020-02-28" GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name HAVING SUM(o.unit) >= 100;

content.description:
Валидный email: имя из букв/цифр/`_`, `@`, домен из букв/цифр, `.`, `com|net|org`. Колонки `user_id`, `name`, `mail`.

[LeetCode 1517](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-users-with-valid-e-mails/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Users(user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, mail TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT user_id, name, mail FROM Users WHERE mail LIKE "%@%.%";
content.referenceSolution: SELECT user_id, name, mail FROM Users WHERE mail REGEXP '^[A-Za-z0-9_]+@[A-Za-z0-9]+\.(com|net|org)$';
